def main():
    n = int(input())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))
    t = int(input())
    
    a.sort()
    num = 0
    
    for i in range(n):
        count = 0
        last = a[i] + t
        for j in range(i, n):
            if a[j] >= a[i] and a[j] <= last:
                count += 1
        if count > num:
            num = count
    
    print(num)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
